reading.title: The Ice Cream Shop 1: A short reading
reading.text: Omar reads the ice-cream menu. He likes vanilla and chocolate, but today he chooses strawberry. Maya asks for mango sorbet in a cup. Omar wants one scoop in a cone. They pay at the counter and sit outside. Maya tastes her sorbet first, while Omar waits for a napkin before eating.
